claude.performance_metric: ~$3.9bn LTC goodwill impairment ~34 months after close; no divestiture
claude.rationale: Section 2 documents that T4 product franchises, T5 pharmacy-fulfillment/distribution operations, and T6 workforce all transferred together with the surviving entity as a going concern, so there is no product-vs-process structural mismatch (gap_45=0) and no process-vs-organization mismatch (gap_56=0). Section 4 explicitly states P4 product-process disruption and P5 process-organization fracture are "None documented," so both are coded 0. The sole documented adverse outcome (Section 3/4) is a ~$3.9bn LTC-reporting-unit goodwill impairment characterized as a value/model-level underperformance, supporting t2_model=1; T1 archetype incoherence is explicitly "None documented" (0).

gemini.rationale: The dossier documents that Omnicare was acquired as a whole entity via a reverse triangular merger, meaning the product (T4), processes (T5), and organization (T6) all transferred together as a going concern without structural gaps (gap_45=0, gap_56=0). Consequently, there is no documented evidence of integration disruption at the product/process (p4_pathway=0) or process/organization (p5_pathway=0) interfaces.
